On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], several kilometers away from the [[ISB Central Office/Legends|ISB Central Office]], was a '''temple''' that was where the [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitorius]] was centralised. While doing reconnaissance around the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|ISB]] Central Office, [[Jax Pavan]] noted the temple as their true home, and that their offices was at the ISB Central Office which was like a home away from home to them.<ref name="CN3" />
